purpose: Independent N2N research quality and discovery review; separate from TSC

queue.identity: Lowercase post ID parsed from a valid NeuronsToNirvana Reddit URL; deduplicate alternate slugs, trailing slashes and annotations.
queue.order: ASCII lexicographic ascending post_id (0-9 then a-z); Reddit IDs are base36, not hexadecimal. This is not chronological/numeric ordering.
queue.resume_rule: Recompute sorted IDs from the pinned source; absent records are PENDING. Select smallest PENDING ID. Leave BLOCKED records visible for retry; never count them complete. On an explicit retry, revisit BLOCKED entries first. Reconcile a new source snapshot explicitly, including newly inserted lower IDs; never rely solely on last_id.

completion_definition.scope: Post and its directly relevant cited sources; comments excluded unless explicitly included. Linked-source recursion is bounded and documented.
requirements: Record actual post access and version/retrieval date without committing source bodies or personal data.
Identify claims and distinguish research, interpretation, testimony and creative material.
Examine available primary sources and document methods, limitations, relevant counterevidence and inaccessible material.
Record duplicate-source relationships and candidate topic/Big Question mappings.
Save a review artifact and explicit scope/limitations. Unexamined material central to the assessment means PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
completion_definition.meaning: COMPLETE means complete for documented scope, never proof of claims, rights clearance, or publication approval.

history_note: No prior review is marked COMPLETE without locating its assessment artifact. Earlier discovery, indexing and metadata enrichment are not full analyses.

boundaries.publication: No automatic publication or integration. This draft records workflow state only.

records.review_scope: Archived record/provenance only; post content and external sources not accessed.
records.assessment: The historical provenance audit identifies the 1000... sequence as a provenance anomaly. It does not prove generation or fabrication. Archive membership and dry-run processing do not establish post existence or substantiate any claim. No substantive scientific assessment is possible from this URL record alone.
records.blocker: No verified post content or primary-source links available in inspected records; live Reddit intake remains HOLD.
records.next_action: Obtain authorised source access or owner-provided material with sufficient provenance; then examine the post and directly relevant primary sources.

records.review_scope: Archived URI and pilot metadata plus existing historical provenance audit; no live Reddit retrieval.
records.assessment: Pilot labels this record community_observation/research_discussion, with unknown date and generic attribution. Its external-source field links back to the same Reddit post, so it supplies no independently identifiable primary study. The summary describes cataloguing rather than substantive findings. Neither methods nor scientific claims can be evaluated from these fields. The existing sequence anomaly is not proof of fabrication.
access_limitations: reddit-semantic-index.csv could not be read through the connector because of file size/support limits; no claim that it contains no further information.
Live Reddit access remains HOLD; post body and linked sources were not examined.
records.blocker: Available metadata is insufficient for substantive analysis; verified post content and primary-source links are missing from inspected records.
records.next_action: Obtain authorised source access or owner-provided material with provenance; resolve the post's identity before substantive assessment.

records.review_scope: Repository-only URI and pilot metadata assessment against the existing historical provenance audit; no live Reddit retrieval.
records.assessment: The pilot labels this record research_discussion/community_observation, with unknown date and generic attribution. Its external-source URL points back to the same Reddit post and supplies no independently identifiable primary study. Its summary describes cataloguing for later review, not substantive findings. Repository metadata does not establish post existence, authorship, or scientific support. The historical sequence anomaly is not proof of fabrication.
access_limitations: The semantic-index fetch returned no usable text; no claim is made that the file is empty or lacks further information.
Post content, comments, media and external primary sources were not accessed; live Reddit access remains HOLD.
records.blocker: Inspected metadata is insufficient for substantive analysis; verified post content and independently identifiable primary-source links are unavailable within the inspected scope.
records.next_action: Resolve source identity using authorised material with provenance before substantive assessment; keep live access on HOLD.

checkpoint.next_action: Review next pending record; retain blocked records for later source verification.
